audit_metadata.title: Final Release Corrections and Independent Verification
audit_metadata.safety_verdict: VERIFIED OFFLINE RESEARCH ONLY -- V5 FROZEN -- ZERO EXECUTION

reconciliation_analysis.mathematical_formula: P(Joint Flag) = P(LB < 0.05 OR Bonferroni Flagged OR McLeod-Li < 0.05)
reconciliation_analysis.theoretical_independence_bound: If the three diagnostic tests were mutually independent, the union rejection probability would be 1 - (1 - 0.05) * (1 - 0.0435) * (1 - 0.05) = 1 - (0.95 * 0.9565 * 0.95) approx 13.68%. Empirical joint rejection is 12.45% because the tests are slightly positively correlated.
reconciliation_analysis.reconciliation_of_c5_4_contradiction: In Direction C.5.4, the 80% pass rate (20% rejection rate) was observed on a small sample of K=100. Under K=2000 calibration, the empirical pass rate is 87.55% (false-positive rejection rate: 12.45%, 95% Wilson CI: [11.07, 13.97]%). The C.5.4 narrative mistakenly conflated individual omnibus test calibration (~3-5%) with the combined gate. Because the joint gate combines three separate tests using an OR rule, its false-positive rate is ~12-14%, NOT 3-5%.
reconciliation_analysis.screening_policy_vs_hypothesis_test: The Joint Pre-Test Gate is a CONSERVATIVE SCREENING FILTER, NOT a calibrated alpha=0.05 hypothesis test. It deliberately accepts a ~12% false-positive rejection rate on pure i.i.d. noise to maximize screening sensitivity against weak autoregression and volatility clustering. It must never be described as a 5% calibrated test.

phase_b_seed_derivation.mathematical_limitation_statement: Zero observed collisions across 50,000 draws confirms empirical dispersion, but does NOT prove mathematical impossibility of collisions in Z_{2^63 - 1}. By the Pigeonhole Principle, any hash projection into a finite field has non-zero collision probability. Under 63-bit integer space, the collision risk for M=50,000 draws is mathematically bounded at ~1.36e-10, which is negligible for audit workloads.

phase_c_strict_numba_equivalence.equivalence_verdict: STRICT ALGEBRAIC EQUIVALENCE CONFIRMED: When evaluated on identical resampling indices, Pure Python, NumPy, and Numba produce replicate statistics that are identical down to floating point machine precision (< 1.00e-16), with 100% exact matches in exceedance counts k and p-values. Discrepancies observed in C.5.4 were 100% caused by PRNG sequence differences, not numerical formula defects.
phase_c_strict_numba_equivalence.architectural_status: Numba remains an isolated optional acceleration utility. The pure-Python standard library implementation in benchmark_engine.py remains the official reference baseline.

Category_A_SCREENING_PASS.label: SCREENING PASS -- ASSUMPTIONS NOT PROVEN
Category_A_SCREENING_PASS.condition: Candidate strategy return series with sample length N >= 500, passing the Joint Pre-Test Gate: Ljung-Box Q10 (p >= 0.05), McLeod-Li Q10 (p >= 0.05), and Bonferroni simultaneous Bartlett bounds (|r_k| < z_{1-0.05/20}/sqrt(N) for all k in 1..10).

block_length_specification.reference_specification: L=10 is retained strictly as an empirical REFERENCE BASELINE specification for N approx 500-1000, NOT as a universally valid or optimal block length. Optimal block length scales asymptotically as O(N^(1/3)).
block_length_specification.mandatory_sensitivity_requirement: Every Category A inference MUST be accompanied by the block-length sensitivity sweep across L in {5, 10, 20}. Block-length sensitivity is strictly a FRAGILITY DIAGNOSTIC. Selecting the minimum p-value across L (p-hacking) is prohibited. If conclusions cross significance thresholds between L=5 and L=20, the result is demoted to Category C.

permitted_statistical_claims: Moving-block bootstrap excess return evaluation relative to benchmark under reference L=10 with reported L in {5, 20} sensitivity.
Omnibus diagnostics did not detect linear autocorrelation or ARCH volatility clustering at the nominal 5% level.
strictly_prohibited_claims: Claims that returns are proven i.i.d., independent, or uncorrelated.
Claims of validated, guaranteed, or forward live profitability.
Claims that nominal bootstrap calibration is mathematically exact without variance inflation.

Category_B_DEPENDENCE_FLAGGED.label: DEPENDENCE FLAGGED -- SENSITIVITY REQUIRED
Category_B_DEPENDENCE_FLAGGED.condition: Linear dependence flagged (Ljung-Box p < 0.05 or Bonferroni Bartlett violated) OR ARCH volatility clustering flagged (McLeod-Li p < 0.05), provided persistence is moderate (|rho_1| < 0.30 and AR(2) root modulus <= 0.50) and N >= 500.
permitted_statistical_claims: Provisional p-values reported strictly across the block length sensitivity sweep L in {5, 10, 20}.
2D DSR sensitivity grid (M in [1, 150], sigma_M in [0.30, 1.00]) displayed with documented variance inflation.
strictly_prohibited_claims: Selecting the minimum p-value across L in {5, 10, 20} (p-hacking).
Presenting unadjusted bootstrap p-values as definitive statistical significance.

Category_C_INCONCLUSIVE.label: INCONCLUSIVE -- CLAIMS BARRED
Category_C_INCONCLUSIVE.condition: Any of the following disqualifying conditions: 1. Sample size N < 500. 2. High autoregressive persistence: |rho_1| >= 0.30 or AR(2) characteristic root modulus > 0.50. 3. Sensitivity instability: bootstrap conclusions cross significance thresholds between L=5 and L=20. 4. Non-convergent bootstrap distributions or structural regime breaks.
permitted_statistical_claims: Statement that the empirical evidence is statistically inconclusive due to excessive persistence, block-length fragility, or inadequate sample size.
strictly_prohibited_claims: Any claim of statistical significance, outperformance, edge, or alpha.

Category_D_STRUCTURAL_LIMITATION.label: STRUCTURAL LIMITATION -- UNVERIFIABLE ASSUMPTIONS
Category_D_STRUCTURAL_LIMITATION.condition: Universal structural constraints of offline quantitative research.
unverifiable_assumptions: Unknown historical trial counts M (including mental and discarded models).
Macro regime non-stationarity across crypto market cycles.
Execution slippage, latency, and queue priority invariance.
permitted_statistical_claims: Explicit documentation of unverified assumptions and sensitivity parameter bounds.
strictly_prohibited_claims: Extrapolating offline statistical metrics directly to live execution expectations.

final_framework_verdict: ACCEPT FOR OFFLINE COMPARATIVE RESEARCH WITH DOCUMENTED LIMITATIONS
